dialogues.jp: 「悪いな、美春。俺は孤高に生きる男なんだ」
dialogues.en: "My apologies Miharu. I am a man of solitude."
dialogues.text: "My apologies Miharu. I am a man of solitude."

dialogues.jp:
手に持っていたパンを片手に、ポーズを決めて
みたりする。
dialogues.en: With one hand holding my bread, I make a sorrowful pose.
dialogues.text: With one hand holding my bread, I make a sorrowful pose.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんですか？　それ」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ひとりで食いたいってことだよ」
dialogues.en: "I want to eat by myself."
dialogues.text: "I want to eat by myself."

dialogues.jp:
ポーズを決めていただけに、わかってもらえな
いとかなり恥ずかしかった。
dialogues.en:
I quickly went back to a normal stance, realizing how
embarassing I must be looking.
dialogues.text:
I quickly went back to a normal stance, realizing how
embarassing I must be looking.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「えー！　そんなこと言わないで一緒に食べま
　しょうよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Huh?! Don't say that, let's eat together~"
dialogues.text: "Huh?! Don't say that, let's eat together~"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今日はひとりで食べるって、朝起きた時から
　決めてたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I already decided I'd be eating alone today when I woke
up."
dialogues.text:
"I already decided I'd be eating alone today when I woke
up."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなの嘘ですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "That's a lie~"
dialogues.text: "That's a lie~"

dialogues.jp: 嘘だった。
dialogues.en: Obviously.
dialogues.text: Obviously.

dialogues.jp: だが、馬鹿正直に嘘でしたと答える義理はない。
dialogues.en: But I had no intention of actually saying that.
dialogues.text: But I had no intention of actually saying that.

dialogues.jp:
自分でもここまで意地をはるのもどうかと思っ
たが、こうなったら最後まで初志を貫き通すま
でだ。
dialogues.en:
Even if it may be stubborn, I wanted to stick to my original
intention as far as possible.
dialogues.text:
Even if it may be stubborn, I wanted to stick to my original
intention as far as possible.

dialogues.jp:
「そんなに連んで食べたかったら、音夢を誘え
　ばいいだろうが」
dialogues.en:
"If you really want to eat lunch together with someone, go
ask Nemu. I'm sure she'd accept."
dialogues.text:
"If you really want to eat lunch together with someone, go
ask Nemu. I'm sure she'd accept."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢先輩が見つからないから、朝倉先輩に声
　をかけてるんですよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't find Nemu anywhere today, so when I heard your
voice, I came to ask you~"
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't find Nemu anywhere today, so when I heard your
voice, I came to ask you~"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「これで朝倉先輩を逃したら、美春、お昼ご飯
　食べられなくなっちゃいますもん」
dialogues.en:
"If I just let you escape now, I won't be able to eat lunch
today!"
dialogues.text:
"If I just let you escape now, I won't be able to eat lunch
today!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、なんだよ、それ？」
dialogues.en: "Hah? Why's that?"
dialogues.text: "Hah? Why's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春、お弁当を用意するの忘れちゃったんで
　すよ。おまけにお財布も忘れちゃって……」
dialogues.en:
"I forgot to make my lunchbox, and I also forgot my purse
today..."
dialogues.text:
"I forgot to make my lunchbox, and I also forgot my purse
today..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「食堂で食べることもできない、と」
dialogues.en: "So you can't eat at the cafeteria."
dialogues.text: "So you can't eat at the cafeteria."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「その通りですっ！」
dialogues.en: "Exactly!"
dialogues.text: "Exactly!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……つまり、俺にオゴレって言ってるんだな、
　お前は」
dialogues.en: "...So basically, you wanted me to treat you."
dialogues.text: "...So basically, you wanted me to treat you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……えーっと……その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah... well... that's..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... well... that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは。さっすが、朝倉先輩！　察しが
　いいですねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahahahaha, just as I expected, Asakura-senpai! Your
perception is fantastic!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahahahaha, just as I expected, Asakura-senpai! Your
perception is fantastic!"

dialogues.jp: 笑って誤魔化す美春。
dialogues.en: Such a wily, deceptive laugh, Miharu.
dialogues.text: Such a wily, deceptive laugh, Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 「ひとりで食え」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to eat alone now."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to eat alone now."

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春を置いて歩き出した。
dialogues.en: I walk away from her.
dialogues.text: I walk away from her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんな〜。待ってくださいよぉ」
dialogues.en: "That...that's~ Please wait~"
dialogues.text: "That...that's~ Please wait~"

dialogues.jp: 切なそうな美春の声が、俺の背中にぶつかる。
dialogues.en: Miharu's pitiful voice struck me from behind.
dialogues.text: Miharu's pitiful voice struck me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みでそこら辺を歩いていた学生達が、何事
かとこちらを見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Students passing by during lunch period all turned and
looked in my direction disapprovingly.
dialogues.text:
Students passing by during lunch period all turned and
looked in my direction disapprovingly.

dialogues.jp: （う。視線が痛い……）
dialogues.en: "(Oof. Those looks...)"
dialogues.text: "(Oof. Those looks...)"

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ち止まると、盛大にため息を吐き出した。
dialogues.en: I stop walking, and let out a monstrous sigh.
dialogues.text: I stop walking, and let out a monstrous sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、和菓子食えたか？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, do you eat wagashis?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu, do you eat wagashis?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え……あ、はい。食べられますよ。バナナの
　方がずっと好きですけど」
dialogues.en: "Eh... ah, yeah. I've eaten them. Bananas are better."
dialogues.text: "Eh... ah, yeah. I've eaten them. Bananas are better."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そんな贅沢はこの際却下だ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think you're in much of a position to be choosy
right now."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think you're in much of a position to be choosy
right now."

dialogues.jp:
小首を傾げた美春の視界から片手を隠し、和菓
子を生み出す。
dialogues.en:
Miharu tilted her head again, which gave me the time I
needed to hide my hand from her field of vision and quickly
create a wagashi.
dialogues.text:
Miharu tilted her head again, which gave me the time I
needed to hide my hand from her field of vision and quickly
create a wagashi.

dialogues.jp:
「俺が食おうと思って開けちまった奴だが……
　やるよ」
dialogues.en: "If you're so hungry, then you can have this... here."
dialogues.text: "If you're so hungry, then you can have this... here."

dialogues.jp: 手の中の大福を美春にグッと差し出す。
dialogues.en: I handed her the daifuku that I just created.
dialogues.text: I handed her the daifuku that I just created.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わっ」
dialogues.en: "Waah!"
dialogues.text: "Waah!"

dialogues.jp: 慌てて受け取る美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu confusedly accepted my gift.
dialogues.text: Miharu confusedly accepted my gift.

dialogues.jp: 「もういいな？」
dialogues.en: "Is that enough?"
dialogues.text: "Is that enough?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい。大福、ありがとうございました〜」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Thank you for this daifuku~"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Thank you for this daifuku~"

dialogues.jp:
美春に背を向けて歩き出し、食べていなかった
パンを大急ぎで口にした。
dialogues.en:
Miharu quickly ran off in another direction, chewing
rapidly.
dialogues.text:
Miharu quickly ran off in another direction, chewing
rapidly.

dialogues.jp:
腹減ってる時に、そう何度も何度もやるもんじゃ
ないなぁ……。
dialogues.en:
She's probably the type who's hungry 24 hours a day, 7 days
a week...
dialogues.text:
She's probably the type who's hungry 24 hours a day, 7 days
a week...

dialogues.jp: ◆美春に和菓子を◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Wagashi for Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Wagashi for Miharu◆

dialogues.jp:
ひとりで食べると言ったのだが、美春は一緒に
食べるのだと聞かない。
dialogues.en:
That I wanted to eat lunch alone, was something Miharu did
not want to hear.
dialogues.text:
That I wanted to eat lunch alone, was something Miharu did
not want to hear.

dialogues.jp:
弁当も財布も忘れてしまった美春は、俺におご
ってもらおうという魂胆だったらしい。
dialogues.en:
Having forgotten both her lunchbox and her purse, she
plotted to ask to eat lunch together first, and explain
later.
dialogues.text:
Having forgotten both her lunchbox and her purse, she
plotted to ask to eat lunch together first, and explain
later.

dialogues.jp:
……ったく。そうならそうと最初から言えばい
いのに。
dialogues.en:
...Geez. If that's what it is, just say so from the start
already.
dialogues.text:
...Geez. If that's what it is, just say so from the start
already.

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春に和菓子を出してやるのだった。
dialogues.en: I created a wagashi and gave it to Miharu for her to eat.
dialogues.text: I created a wagashi and gave it to Miharu for her to eat.
